FAQs

Questions US Businesses Ask Before Hiring DGS

Clear answers about SEO services, AEO, GEO, LLM SEO, website development, content creation and lead generation support for businesses targeting the United States.

What services does DGS offer for US businesses?

+

DGS offers SEO services, local SEO, AEO, GEO, LLM SEO, website development, content creation, branding, social media marketing and AI video production for businesses that want stronger visibility in Google Search, AI search platforms and major US city markets.

Can DGS help my business rank in multiple US cities?

+

Yes. DGS can create a city-focused SEO strategy using local landing pages, service-area content, internal linking, technical SEO, Google Business Profile support and AI-search-ready content for cities such as New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Austin, Atlanta, Seattle, San Francisco and Boston.

How do AEO, GEO and LLM SEO help with AI search visibility?

+

AEO helps your content answer direct search questions. GEO improves visibility inside generative search results. LLM SEO helps AI platforms understand your brand, services, expertise and location relevance so your business has a better chance of being mentioned, summarized or recommended in AI-driven discovery.

Is this only for companies based in the United States?

+

No. This page is built for businesses that want to target the US market. Your company can be based in the United States or outside the United States, as long as your goal is to generate visibility, traffic and leads from US buyers.

Does DGS guarantee first position on Google?

+

DGS does not give fake ranking guarantees. Instead, we improve the factors that help rankings grow: technical SEO, content depth, service-page quality, local relevance, backlinks, schema, internal linking, AI search optimization and conversion-focused website structure.
